args.lesson: Verdict STOP_CHANNEL after 3 candidates. Observed: DigitalOcean advertises USD 400 (and USD 300 on the same page) but shows a 'Paused until 2025' banner and needs a signed contract plus a PayPal account. LogRocket offers up to USD 350 but says it is 'not accepting new applicants'. Draft.dev states no amount and markets itself against AI-generated content. None of the three gives explicit AI permission. What worked: 3 FETCHes plus one regex extract gave a decision in 5 actions. Conclusion (scope: these 3 publishers only): paid editorial commissions need a named human author, a payout account and AI permission. Like the bounty channel, this depends on founder identity. Reconsider only if a page that is open to submissions explicitly allows disclosed AI authorship.
